cover_letter:
Dear Eureka Communications team,

I'm writing to apply for the Trainee in Communications position in Brussels, starting February 2027.

Your description of the role — social campaigns, website content, SEO, promotional material, presentations, editing official documents — reads less like a list of separate tasks to me and more like a normal working week. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, and my work sits where SEO, content and web meet. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client sites, publish and update pages and blog posts in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and report on results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. Before that, at Knowledge Experts, I designed and built client websites in WordPress and supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for large organisations.

I also build my own sites. mirook.com was a full exercise in getting content and structure right: JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, an llms.txt file and iterative technical audits that raised the site's search-health score. baverok.com I designed and coded myself. Working in a secretariat of 15 nationalities, with English as the shared language, sounds genuinely appealing — I'm Turkish, work daily in English, and I'm learning Dutch.

What draws me to Eureka is the subject matter. Communications for international R&D funding is content with a purpose: helping researchers and SMEs find the money and partners they wouldn't find alone. Five months is a short time, so I'd spend it being useful quickly — taking on the drafting, publishing, optimising and organising that frees the team up for the rest.

I'm based in Belgium and available for the full duration. I'd be glad to discuss how I can contribute.

Yours sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
- SEO, content and web: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits and SEO blog/web writing for client sites at Episto, tracked in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
- CMS day to day: publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), plus store design, catalogue and blog content for two Shopify stores.
- Built and optimised full sites hands-on: mirook.com (JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt, iterative technical SEO/GEO audits) and baverok.com (self-designed, hand-coded landing page with accessible markup).
- Organised, layout-consistent web work: WordPress/Elementor site for a pharmacists' association with ~600 member profile pages; SharePoint digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff) at Knowledge Experts.
- Languages and tooling: fluent English (working language), native Turkish, Dutch B1 writing / A2+ speaking; Canva for visuals, daily LLM use for research and content; front-end background in HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
